m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>There is an extremely long lecture about Celestian philosophy, astronomy, and magic theory. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>At the end of the lecture, the Preceptor produces a small metal token for you. Shiny! </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The Preceptor lectures for a little while about identifying and resolving disagreements of all sort. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>When the lecture is complete, the Preceptor produces a small metal token for you. Congratulations! </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The Preceptor speaks at length about the creation of devices with magical properties. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>When it is finished lecturing you, the Preceptor produces a small metal token for you. Good job! </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You fit the three course completion tokens into slots on the security plinth. </ITALICS>
I am the Archivist, a construct created to aid research in the Astral Archive.
My empathic array detects that you are here searching for a means of entry into the Stellarium. Is that correct?
Only Celestian citizens are permitted unrestricted access to the Stellarium.
Temporary access to the Stellarium may be granted by allowing an empathic scan to determine suitability.
Please present yourself to the Preceptors of Configuration, Conflict, and Contrivance for your evaluation.
Once finished, return with the tokens denoting successful completion and place them in the security plinth.
The Preceptors have been activated and are ready for your use.
The Preceptors of Configuration, Conflict, and Contrivance are activated and await your use. Return here when finished.
